document.description: A valid Schengen visa can unlock visa-free entry or simplified entry procedures in certain non-Schengen destinations, subject to each destination's conditions

unlocks.conditions: Valid multiple-entry Schengen visa that has previously been used in a Schengen state
unlocks.notes: Visa exemption applies to foreign citizens who would otherwise require an Albanian visa.
Stay may not extend beyond the Schengen visa's expiry when its remaining validity is less than 30 days.
Visa-free entry, transit and stay is permitted for up to 90 days during a six-month period and within the visa's validity.

unlocks.conditions: Multiple-entry Schengen type C visa valid for at least five days beyond the intended stay
unlocks.notes: Maximum 15 days per entry, with total stay limited to 90 days in any 180-day period.
For nationals normally subject to the Bosnia and Herzegovina visa regime. One continuous stay may not exceed 30 days, with total stay capped at 90 days in any 180-day period and within visa validity.

unlocks.conditions: Valid visa, other than a transit visa, issued by an EU member state or a Schengen Agreement state
unlocks.notes: The exemption applies to nationals identified by Moldova's visa-regime list and lasts within the supporting visa's validity.
Mexican visa exemption applies for tourism, business, transit or study without remuneration from a Mexican source, subject to immigration authorization at entry.
Belize lists a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa as an exemption from the Belize entry-visa requirement for visits not exceeding 30 days.
Citizens who normally require a Kosovo visa are exempt for entry, transit or stay for up to 15 days when holding a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa.

unlocks.conditions: Valid visa or residence issued by a qualifying country, including an EU member state; a Schengen visa issued by an EU member state can satisfy this route
unlocks.notes: Current Panama guidance cites Executive Decrees 521 and 196. Decree 196 removed the former six-month minimum remaining-validity condition, requiring the qualifying visa to be valid at entry.

unlocks.conditions: For specified nationalities applying for a Georgian e-Visa, a valid Schengen visa is accepted as a required supporting document
unlocks.notes: This is a simplified e-Visa eligibility privilege rather than universal visa-free entry. It applies only to nationalities listed by Georgia's e-Visa portal.
